title: Peer Review for Professional Materials
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting peer review for professional materials to peer review feedback log, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Produce located, actionable peer feedback (location + problem + question) that preserves the writer's ownership
Distinguish artifact polish from evidence-based revision
Apply the professional-materials privacy boundary: strip a peer's identifying data before any third-party tool use, or review it yourself
Use feedback, support requests, and revision notes to improve the artifact before sharing it

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
